sloka: हृता सीता विशालाक्षि याम् त्वम् गृह्य न बुध्यसे ।महाबलम् महात्मानम् दुराधर्षम् सुरैरपि ॥६-२०-२९॥।।
transliteration: hṛtā sītā viśālākṣi yām tvam gṛhya na budhyase ।mahābalam mahātmānam durādharṣam surairapi ॥6-20-29॥।।

translations.english: "You do not understand that the foremost of Raghu's, a benevolent one, is difficult to overcome even for Indra. He will take away your life with his extraordinary might."
